test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select No error’.

The Gryffindors trooped back up / to the castle, none of them talking; / it have been another long day.

options.text: it have been another long day.
to the castle, none of them talking;

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **segment** that contains a grammatical **error** is: *'It have been another long day.'*
 
• The **correct phrase** should be **"it had been another long day."**
 
• The auxiliary verb **"have" **is incorrectly used in this context.
 
• When speaking about something that happened in the past, **"had"** is the **correct auxiliary** verb to use, not **"have".**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* "The Gryffindors trooped back up to the castle, none of them talking; it had been another long day*."
